name: Brooklyn Hayes
source:
"I'd like to experience love like in the novels, however, fiction is not reality." 

A businessman with a penchant for historical romance and recreational ironing, Brooklyn is dedicated to forging his own path in life. He pines for true romance but shies away from letting anyone too close. Instead, he spends any free time alone in his castle-like mansion. No matter the situation, he is always polished, gentlemanly, and ready to serve you a nice cup of tea.

Facts:
• Once spent an entire weekend dusting
• Wishes he lived in the Victorian era
• Will rearrange floral centerpieces if left unattended

[From the [url=https://www.velvetfoxgames.com/infiniteblue.html]official website[/url]]
